Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 5, 2026

Nx. Inc., a corporation incorporated under the laws of Ontario, Canada ("Nx.", "we", "us", or "our"), controls the personal information you give us on http://www.nxgrowth.ai. This policy applies worldwide.

What we collect and why

  • When you request a demo: your name, company, job title, business email, phone number and any message you send.
  • When you browse: IP address, browser type, pages viewed and approximate location, through cookies.

We use this to respond to your request, run the demo, follow up about Nx., keep the Site secure, and understand how it is used. Under the GDPR and similar laws, our legal bases are taking steps at your request before a contract, our legitimate interest in responding to business inquiries, and your consent for marketing and analytics cookies where the law requires it. We do not use this information to train AI models or for automated decisions that significantly affect you. Please do not send us sensitive information.

Sharing, transfers and retention

We do not sell or share your personal information for advertising. We disclose it only to service providers that host the Site and run our CRM, email, scheduling, video calls and analytics, to professional advisers, to authorities where the law requires, and to a successor in a merger or acquisition.

We are based in Canada, and our providers may process data in Canada, the United States and other countries, where local authorities may be able to access it. Transfers from the EU, UK and Switzerland to Canada rely on adequacy decisions; onward transfers use Standard Contractual Clauses or equivalent safeguards. Transfers from mainland China follow PIPL requirements, including separate consent where required.

We keep demo request data for up to 24 months after our last contact, unless you become a customer or ask us to delete it sooner. We protect it with encryption in transit, access controls and vetted providers.

Your rights

You can ask to access, correct, delete or receive a copy of your information, object to or restrict its use, or withdraw consent at any time. Email hello@nx-growth.com. We will verify your identity, respond within the time your law requires (one month in the EU/UK, 45 days in the US), and never treat you differently for asking.

EU, UK and Switzerland: You may also complain to your data protection authority.

US states including California: In the past 12 months we collected identifiers, professional information and internet activity, from you and your device, for the purposes above. We have not sold or shared it. You may use an authorized agent and appeal our decision. We honor Global Privacy Control signals; we do not respond to Do Not Track signals, as no common standard exists.

Canada: You may also complain to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

Mainland China: You may also ask us to explain our processing rules.

Elsewhere: You have the rights your local law provides.

Marketing, cookies and children

We send marketing emails only as the law allows, including Canada's anti-spam law (CASL), and every email has an unsubscribe link. We use your phone number only about your demo request. We use necessary cookies and, with your consent where required, analytics cookies; manage them in our cookie banner. The Site is not meant for anyone under 18.

Changes and contact

We will post updates here with a new effective date and notify you of material changes. Questions or requests: hello@nx-growth.com
